# NSAI — Not So Artificial Intelligence
> Source: https://nsai.tech

## What is NSAI?

NSAI (Not So Artificial Intelligence) is a sovereign, self-hosted AI business operating system built by Not So Holdings LLC. The flagship product is **NUB** — an autonomous AI agent that runs 24/7 on any Debian-based device (VPS, Android via Termux PRoot, mini PC) and manages business operations through Telegram and Discord.

## Products

- **NUB Installer** ($197 one-time) — Full AI OS installer for Debian/Termux/VPS. Includes OpenClaw MCP gateway, 19+ tools, Telegram + Discord channels, Ollama local LLM.
- **NUB Installer + Onboarding** ($297 one-time) — Includes 1hr live setup, custom Notion workspace, Gumroad/Stripe wired in, 3 custom MCP tools.
- **Sovereign** (custom) — White-label, hardware pre-flashed, OSINT pipelines, concierge support.

- Founded by Justin Perry / Not So Holdings LLC (Florida)
